needed.evidence: A continuous, purpose-built sidewalk is present on the left side, but it is partially obstructed by parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Relocate the on-street parking to a designated off-street area to clear the sidewalk.

needed.evidence: The sidewalk on the right is partially blocked by a large advertising sign and a pedestrian.
needed.suggestion: Enforce a clear zone on the sidewalk by removing the advertising sign and relocating it to a less obstructive position.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the presence of shops and a bus stop, but the only visible crossing is a marked zebra crossing which is not a purpose
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at the location of the existing zebra crossing to provide a safer and more controlled crossing point.

needed.evidence: The kerbs at the marked crossing do not appear to be dropped, which would make it difficult for wheeled users to cross.
needed.suggestion: Construct a raised crossing platform with dropped kerbs to improve accessibility and safety for all users.
